title: LangGraph vs CrewAI
summary: LangGraph models an agent as an explicit graph/state machine and treats durable execution and human-in-the-loop as first-class primitives; CrewAI models a system as a crew of role-playing agents. Both are MIT-licensed Python projects.
summaryZh: LangGraph 把 Agent 建模为显式的图/状态机，并把持久化执行与 human-in-the-loop 作为一等原语；CrewAI 则把系统建模为一组扮演角色的 Agent 团队（crew）。两者都是 MIT 许可的 Python 项目。
